name: What should I look for in a home remodeling contract?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for in a home remodeling contract?

acceptedAnswer.text: A comprehensive home remodeling contract should clearly outline the scope of work, including detailed descriptions of all tasks, materials, and finishes. It must specify the project timeline, payment schedule, and total cost. Ensure it includes provisions for change orders, warranty information, and proof of the contractor's insurance and licensing. Read the fine print carefully. City Dweller, LLC provides clear, detailed contracts to protect both parties and ensure transparency throughout the remodeling process.
acceptedAnswer.description: A contract should detail the scope of work, timeline, costs, payment schedule, change order process, warranty, and proof of insurance/licensing. Review it carefully.
